defective_pattern: Dumping raw markdown syntax, unparsed pipe tables, and string escapes into .docx files via naive string fallbacks
why_defective: Results in unprofessional deliverable artifacts displaying plain markdown syntax instead of formatted Word tables and styles, violating formatting constraints.
observed_symptoms: Raw markdown pipe tables in DOCX output
String escapes like \n visible in text
Lack of native Word styles for headings and tables
corrective_remedy: Use a robust Markdown to OpenXML AST compiler or python-docx library to natively build tables, apply paragraph styles, and insert runs.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Deterministic regex pattern matching the defect
